summary: Validate SOURCE table and column identifiers; hash publisher assertions, preserve unchanged open versions, close omitted replacement members and compile replayable SOURCE mutations.

en.description: Validate SOURCE table and column identifiers; hash publisher assertions, preserve unchanged open versions, close omitted replacement members and compile replayable SOURCE mutations.
